answer.text: The rate of change of delta with respect to change in the price of the underlying asset
The rate of change of option premium with respect to time
The rate of change of premium with respect to volatility
The rate of change of premium with respect to interest rates

explanation.text: The Logic: Gamma is defined as the change in an option's delta per unit change in the price of the underlying asset, equivalently the second derivative of the option price with respect to the underlying. The Trap: Sensitivity of premium to time is theta, sensitivity to volatility is vega, and sensitivity to interest rates is rho. Gamma is specifically the rate of change of delta. Note: Workbook reference — p.74 (gamma as change in option delta per unit change in underlying and as the second derivative of option price).
